title: DevX SDK daily scratchpad - docs + sample apps TODOs
content:
Daily scratchpad - focus: SDK docs gaps, sample apps, tutorials (quick notes)

Top priorities (today):
- Finish quickstart fix for python/streaming example (users hit broken example when they try streaming + tool-calls)
  - Repro steps: 
    1) pip install redwood-sdk==0.4.2
    2) run examples/streaming_tool_call.py -> hangs at serialize step
  - Suspect: streaming client builder changed signature in PR #421 (link above)
  - TODO: write minimal reproducer + open issue if patch needed

- Sample apps: node-chat-demo missing env var docs
  - Add .env.example and document expected REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_KEY
  - Add note about region param (us-west-2 default) and how Dedicated customers set endpoint

Doc gaps found during user testing (last week):
- No clear guidance for "pinning model versions" in hosted API quickstart (users expect a simple flag)
  - Action: add short bullet under config: model_version: "rwd-ft-1.2"
- Missing section on "cost-aware batching" (Optimize) - link to optimize playbook in product repo
  - Action: draft 200-300 word explainer + example config
- Tutorials: step that shows how to enable function calling with typed schemas is too terse
  - Add a full example with small typed schema + response validation snippet

Unresolved questions / blockers:
- Should we include pre-built prompts for the sample apps or point to examples/prompts repo? (ask PM)
- What is the recommended approach for Dedicated customers that want on-prem HSM KMS -> need infra input (Ping Alex W.)

Meeting notes (standup 2026-03-03):
- Olivia: will take python quickstart bug; aim to post PR by EOD Thursday
- Devon: will update node-chat-demo env docs and add .env.example
- Me (Samantha): draft section for pinning models + batching explainer; coordinate with product for wording

Quick TODO list (short):
- [ ] Create minimal repro for streaming hang + link to PR #421
- [ ] Update python quickstart README (streaming example) and add CI test
- [ ] Add .env.example to node-chat-demo
- [ ] Draft "pin model version" blurb in hosted-api quickstart
- [ ] Draft cost-aware batching explainer + example config
- [ ] Follow up with infra (Alex Wu) re: HSM/KMS guidance for Dedicated
- [ ] Close RED-1132 after confirming reproduction

Notes to self:
- Keep updates terse - this doc is a scratchpad, not final copy.
- When writing examples, include both curl and SDK snippets (py + js).
- Add small e2e smoke test that runs example in CI (fast: 5s)

Links referenced:
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/421
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/DEVX/SDK-Docs-Plan
- Jira: RED-1132

End of scratchpad.
